in_marathi.name: Bhagya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bhag’, Bhagya represents the bestowal of good fortune and prosperity. It is a name associated with the Hindu goddess Saraswati, the goddess of wisdom, knowledge, and learning. Bhagya is also linked to the story of the Mahabharata, where it is the name of the sister of Bhima and wife of Duryodhana.
